body:
Founder created a real upstream repo, SPIDERBEETLE, for the PARENA Android/Java-target work (kanban cruise-queue card 32445324). Cloned locally, set up with real README/CLAUDE.md/NORTHSTAR.md/CHANGELOG.md. Real, checked-in content, not a blank stub: app/src/main/java/industrial/einhorn/spiderbeetle/generated/BatteryUi.java, compiled fresh via the real parena build (Java target) from PARENA/stdlib/android/battery_ui.prn at its own real Maven/Gradle-convention output path (package declaration derives automatically via parena's own java_package_name_from_path). Verified with an actual JDK (javac/java 25.0.4) against smoke_test/Main.java -- 7 real assertions, all pass, re-verified from this repo's own real checked-out tree, not just copied output. Real, honest scoping in NORTHSTAR.md (moved from PARENA/docs/ANDROID_JAVA_TARGET_NORTHSTAR.md, which now just points here, same real precedent BURROW's own DUNG.md set): this sandbox has no Android SDK at all, and MJOLNIR itself has no gradlew checked out locally either, so a real, buildable Android APK is honestly named as the real, concrete, unattempted next step rather than guessed-at unverified scaffolding. Registered in the root monorepo CLAUDE.md's own repo table and EMILY/context/golden-docs-index.md (moved from the old PARENA doc entry). Commit d583673.

⚓ ☃
title: Real home established for the PARENA-Java-emitter Android app (SPIDERBEETLE, kanban 32445324)
